content_sections.heading: BRAOU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the BRAOU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download BRAOU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Part Time Lecturer: A Master degree with 55% marks in a concerned subject from an Indian University. Cleared NET/SLET/SET conducted by UGC/CSIR or awarded a Ph.D degree in accordance with UGC Minimum Standards for Award of Ph.D regulations 2020. Writing and Reading skills in Telugu is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written test (Maximum marks: 70) Performance in Interview (Maximum marks: 30)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for BRAOU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Open University (BRAOU) located in Hyderabad, Telangana, to fill temporary positions for academic sessions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under BRAOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 26 vacancies available for the Part Time Lecturer position across various subjects including English, Mathematics, Computer Science, and more.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 07-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they submit their documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for BRAOU Part Time Lecturer?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through Email by sending their bio-data along with relevant photocopies of documents to the designated placement cell email address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned subject along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree, plus Telugu reading and writing skills.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these temporary Part Time Lecturer positions at BRAOU.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test carrying a maximum of 70 marks and performance in an interview carrying a maximum of 30 marks.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application be emailed?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to the Placement Officer at the Placement Cell or sent directly to [email protected] as specified in the guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Are these positions permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The positions announced by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Open University for Part Time Lecturers are temporary in nature to serve academic requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the important links section provided in this article and clicking on the designated link.
